snapshot.description: Deferred P2 findings from review of serverdesktop shared MapLibre basemap: Google public Street/Hybrid composite raster details cannot be independently toggled by MapLibre layer IDs; Vector offline requires packaging style-resolved vector tiles plus glyph/sprite assets. Revisit only after provider/source capability is explicitly selected and licensed. Current UI must keep the limitation visible and must not treat project data as basemap content.
snapshot.title: Review follow-up: provider-specific MapLibre layer and Vector offline support
